hero.title: Track Vietnamese meals
hero.subtitle: Describe your meal the way you'd tell a friend — in Vietnamese, English, or both. Kallo knows phở, bánh mì, and 500+ Vietnamese dishes, and how you cook them, then estimates the nutrition from Vietnamese food-composition data.

demo.smartContextText: Uses your region, cooking habits, and meal text to tighten estimates.

problem.label: Why current apps fail
problem.title: The problem with
problem.subtitle: Built for Western diets. Most trackers don't know the difference between phở bò and phở gà, or that your bún bò Huế has more chili oil than usual.
problem.card1Text: Western-centric food databases with wrong portions and missing Vietnamese dishes.
problem.card2Text: Searching ingredient by ingredient, guessing portions, and giving up after a few days.
problem.card3Text: A stir-fry with minimal oil vs. deep-fried — same ingredient, very different calories.

visual.caption: Two near-misses and a shrug — for a dish eaten in millions of homes.

problem.quote: When the food database doesn't understand your cuisine, every calorie target becomes a guess.

solution.step1Text: Type the meal the way you naturally would — in Vietnamese, English, or a mix of both.
solution.step1TextMobile: Describe your meal naturally in Vietnamese, English, or both.
solution.step2Title: We break it into real ingredients
solution.step2Text: Kallo maps your description to Vietnamese ingredients and dish components from a curated nutrition dataset.
solution.step2TextMobile: Kallo maps your text to real Vietnamese ingredients and dish components.
solution.step3Text: Region, cooking habits, and nutrition goals help the AI understand hidden calories and likely portion adjustments.
solution.step3TextMobile: Region, cooking habits, and goals help the AI tighten the estimate.
solution.step4Title: You get one number you can trust
solution.step4Text: Kallo gives you one calorie and macro number you can trust, built from real Vietnamese food data and how you actually cook.
solution.step4TextMobile: One number you can trust, built from real Vietnamese food data.
solution.whyTitle: Built around how Vietnamese meals are actually eaten
solution.feature1Text: Matches meals against Vietnamese food composition data instead of forcing Western substitutes.
solution.feature2Text: Understands modifiers like less scallion oil, extra broth, or home-style braising habits.
solution.feature3Text: Every estimate is grounded in Vietnamese food-composition data, so the numbers hold up when you make decisions.
